column1: # Microsoft 365 Excel (en-US) functions: the vetted name and minimum-arity list behind
# eval/catalog/functions.yaml (T-0040). Committed so it never needs re-fetching.
#   521 names ("FIND, FINDB" style rows split). Five more (COPILOT, FIELDVALUE, IMPORTCSV, IMPORTTEXT, PY)
#   come from the function index on every per-function page, which the alphabetical table lacks;
#   HIDDEN there is excluded ("available only in another language version").
#   ECMA.CEILING is in neither; it was added from oracle evidence (probes/ecma-ceiling, T-1301).
# min_args: argument positions a call must have, from the Syntax section of each function's page
#   [brackets]. A leading optional argument still takes its position (REDUCE([initial_value], array, ...)).
#   Corrections to the page text are explained in `note`. Probe cases probes/catalog/availability-*
#   call every in-scope name with exactly min_args arguments (Excel for the web loaded each one).
# ms_category: the label in the alphabetical table (empty for the five index-only names).
# Columns (tab-separated): name, ms_category, min_args, syntax, page, note
